0022600042.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder (8-3, 2nd in the Northwest, 5th in the West, with a 3-3 road record) visit the 2-8 LA Clippers (13th in the West, 0-5 on the road) for their 13th game of the season, coming off a loss that snapped a seven-game stretch of wins in their last ten. Missing for the Thunder are Ajay Mitchell (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Jaylin Williams (back spasms), and Thomas Sorber (knee), while the Clippers are without Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles, surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder, surgery), Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot, surgery), and Cam Christie, who is day-to-day with an ankle injury and a game-time decision. The Thunder lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 108-101 win in Oklahoma City on October 25, and they also won all three meetings in the 2025-26 season.
